positions.name: ReactionDeliveryBundlingAndBatchingBoundary
positions.frame: How should reaction notifications be bundled across multi-skill execution runs, and where should batching window boundaries be enforced against per-skill delivery alternatives?
positions.why: This position groups the core policy ruling on reaction delivery routing: establishing server-side bundling per run per person to protect recipient cognitive load, enforcing a strict batching close boundary when the run closes despite pushback, and explicitly recording the rejection of per-skill delivery with client-side collapsing to avoid shifting the ordering burden onto the reader.
